response.sql:
WITH per_transaction AS (
  SELECT
    transref,
    AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY transref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg
  FROM per_transaction
),
kept AS (
  SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anlycount, o.overall_avg
  FROM per_transaction AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE p.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg
),
kept_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS kept_avg
  FROM kept
)
SELECT
  k.transref,
  k.avg_anlycount,
  k.avg_anlycount - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg,
  k.avg_anlycount - ka.kept_avg AS above_kept_avg
FROM kept AS k
CROSS JOIN kept_average AS ka
ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Transactions with no non-NULL anlycount have a NULL average and are excluded from the overall average and the kept results, consistent with SQL AVG semantics.
